title: Eegdota Iddoo Biqiltuu
intro: Iddoo biqiltuu baala qabu keessatti hawaasni tokko waadaa cimaa seene. Garuu murtoon isaanii kan qoratame yeroo fedhiin Waaqayyoo gidduu seenee, arjummaa isaanii gara lafa gogaa ta’etti jijjiire.
clues: Iddoo biqiltuu baayʼee taʼeen eebbifamne, garuu of tuulummaa qabna turre.
Harka qalleeyyii waliin osoo hin qoodamin haamuuf karoora baasne.
Karoora keenyatti ofitti amanamummaadhaan ganama barii kaane.
Yeroo achi geenyu garuu, iddoon biqiltuu keenya halkan tokkotti akka diigame arganne.
Dogoggora keenya hubannee wal komachuu jalqabne.
Dhumarratti gaabbii galchine, garuu barumsi sun yeroon isaa darbe.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
